note: CH-10 high-resolution head variant. One variable: an extra P2/4 (stride 4) detection level (configs/models/yolo11s-p2.yaml). Starting checkpoint from scripts/make_p2_init.py: all 499 baseline tensors (the same yolo11s.pt transfer the baseline trainer does) plus a fresh 64-tensor P2 branch (results/ch-10-yolo-tuning/p2_transfer.json). Everything else equals yolo_baseline_marko_3050: imgsz 1344, full 2,800-frame train_rubric x 6 epochs = 16,800 images, batch 1, workers 0, cache false, AMP, seed 42, flip-only, optimizer=auto, nbs 64. Hypothesis, stated before training: a stride-4 level gives tiny objects (a few px at stride 8) their own anchor points, so AP_small and dense frames should improve; the new branch starts untrained, so 6 epochs may be too short for it, and 4x more anchor points cost speed.
